ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) pre-encryption Safe Mode boot + recovery destruction chain
ucs.description: Hunts Qilin/Agenda's signature pre-detonation sequence on a single host: bcdedit configuring `safeboot` to reboot the victim into Safe Mode (bypassing EDR/AV agents), paired with shadow-copy / backup catalog destruction (vssadmin, wmic shadowcopy, wbadmin). Sophos X-Ops and Microsoft documented this exact chain as a defining Qilin TTP for the Rust variant.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first max(_time) as last values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as bins from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("bcdedit.exe","vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe") AND Processes.user!="*$" by Processes.dest Processes.user | eval safeboot=if(match(mvjoin(cmds," "),"(?i)safeboot"),1,0), destroyrec=if(match(mvjoin(cmds," "),"(?i)(delete\s+shadows|shadowcopy\s+delete|delete\s+catalog|recoveryenabled\s+no)"),1,0), span=tonumber(last)-tonumber(first) | where safeboot=1 AND destroyrec=1 AND span<=900 | convert ctime(first) ctime(last) | table first last Processes.dest Processes.user safeboot destroyrec cmds
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 15m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot")
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled" and ProcessCommandLine has "no")
     or (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "catalog")
| extend Bucket = case(
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot", "SafeBoot",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled", "DisableRecovery",
    "DestroyShadows")
| summarize First=min(Timestamp), Last=max(Timestamp),
            Cmds=make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            Buckets=make_set(Bucket),
            Parents=make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMin)
| where array_length(Buckets) >= 2
| extend HasSafeBoot = Buckets has "SafeBoot"
| where HasSafeBoot
| order by First desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 15m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has "safeboot")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has "recoveryenabled" and CommandLine has "no")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has "catalog")
| extend Bucket = case(
    NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has "safeboot", "SafeBoot",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has "recoveryenabled", "DisableRecovery",
    "DestroyShadows")
| summarize First=min(TimeGenerated), Last=max(TimeGenerated),
            Cmds=make_set(CommandLine, 25),
            Buckets=make_set(Bucket),
            Parents=make_set(ParentProcessName, 10)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMin)
| where array_length(Buckets) >= 2
| where Buckets has "SafeBoot"
| order by First desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Ransomware Safe-Mode Boot Preparation (bcdedit safeboot)
id: 9c5a3b71-2d8e-4a1c-9b2e-7fa6c4b1d9e0
status: experimental
description: Detects bcdedit being used to configure Windows Safe Mode boot, a Qilin/Agenda ransomware preparatory step to reboot victims into Safe Mode where most EDR/AV drivers are not loaded, prior to file encryption.
references:
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/22/qilin-ransomware-caught-stealing-credentials-stored-in-google-chrome/
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2024/03/qilin-ransomware/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2024/09/01
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.t1490
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
  selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'safeboot'
  filter_legit_admin:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\msconfig.exe'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cli and not filter_legit_admin
falsepositives:
  - IT administrators troubleshooting boot issues via scripted MDT/SCCM tasks
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *SafeBoot* OR *SAFEBOOT* OR *recoveryenabled*)) OR (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"* OR *"DELETE SHADOWS"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"ShadowCopy Delete"*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/(bcdedit|vssadmin|wmic|wbadmin)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(safeboot|delete\\s+shadows|shadowcopy\\s+delete|delete\\s+catalog|recoveryenabled\\s+no)", field=CommandLine)
| Bucket := if(regex("(?i)safeboot", field=CommandLine), then="SafeBoot", else=if(regex("(?i)recoveryenabled", field=CommandLine), then="DisableRecovery", else="DestroyShadows"))
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(as=Hits), count(field=Bucket, distinct=true, as=Variety), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, Bucket])], limit=200)
| Variety >= 2
| Bucket contains "SafeBoot"
ucs.rationale: Safe-mode-then-encrypt is a defining Qilin/Agenda trademark: the Rust variant accepts a `--safe-mode` argument and operators pair it with shadow-copy destruction to ensure encryption survives reboot and runs without EDR. ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin domain-wide Chrome credential harvest via GPO logon PowerShell script
ucs.description: Hunts the Qilin-specific tradecraft Sophos X-Ops disclosed in August 2024: after compromising a domain controller the actor pushes a malicious GPO that drops a PowerShell logon script (IPScanner.ps1 / LogonScript.bat) which copies every user's Chrome `Login Data` SQLite file to a UNC share at logon, generating a fan-out of identical credential-harvest activity across hundreds of endpoints in a short window — a pattern unique to Qilin among 2024 RaaS crews.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first max(_time) as last values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.dest) as hosts dc(Processes.dest) as host_count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("gpscript.exe","userinit.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe") by Processes.user Processes.process_hash | eval cred_target=if(match(mvjoin(cmds," "),"(?i)(Login\s+Data|Chrome\\\\User\s+Data|Edge\\\\User\s+Data|BraveSoftware|Mozilla\\\\Firefox|CryptUnprotectData|AesGcm|Encrypted_key|Cookies\.sqlite)"),1,0) | where cred_target=1 | convert ctime(first) ctime(last) | sort - host_count
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let CredTargets = dynamic([@"\Google\Chrome\User Data\", @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\", @"\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\User Data\", @"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\", @"\Opera Software\Opera"]);
let CredKeywords = dynamic(["Login Data","Web Data","Cookies","CryptUnprotectData","AesGcm","Encrypted_key","IPScanner","LogonScript.bat"]);
let Procs =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("gpscript.exe","userinit.exe")
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (CredKeywords)
       or ProcessCommandLine has_any (CredTargets)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, ProcessHash = SHA256;
let Files =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("Login Data","Login Data For Account","Web Data","Cookies")
    | where FolderPath has_any (CredTargets)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","robocopy.exe","xcopy.exe")
    | where InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ ("gpscript.exe","userinit.exe")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, FileTouched=FolderPath, InitCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
union Procs, Files
| summarize Hosts=make_set(DeviceName, 200), HostCount=dcount(DeviceName),
            Users=make_set(AccountName, 50),
            SampleCmd=any(coalesce(ProcessCommandLine, InitCmd)),
            First=min(Timestamp), Last=max(Timestamp)
            by SignatureKey = coalesce(ProcessHash, tostring(hash(SampleCmd)))
| where HostCount >= 3
| order by HostCount desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let CredKeywords = dynamic(["Login Data","Web Data","Cookies","Chrome\\User Data","Edge\\User Data","BraveSoftware","Mozilla\\Firefox","CryptUnprotectData","AesGcm","Encrypted_key","IPScanner","LogonScript.bat"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\gpscript.exe" or ParentProcessName endswith "\\userinit.exe"
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\cmd.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\wscript.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\cscript.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any (CredKeywords)
| summarize Hosts=make_set(Computer, 200), HostCount=dcount(Computer),
            Users=make_set(SubjectUserName, 50),
            SampleCmd=any(CommandLine), Parents=make_set(ParentProcessName, 5),
            First=min(TimeGenerated), Last=max(TimeGenerated)
            by Signature = substring(CommandLine, 0, 200)
| where HostCount >= 3
| order by HostCount desc

id: 4f7d2c19-8b3a-4e6d-a1c7-6e2f9b8d4c11
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell/cmd/wscript spawned from gpscript.exe (GPO logon-script host) or userinit.exe and referencing browser credential stores. Matches Qilin/Agenda's August 2024 tradecraft of pushing a malicious domain GPO to harvest Chrome Login Data from every endpoint at user logon.
references:
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/22/qilin-ransomware-caught-stealing-credentials-stored-in-google-chrome/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2024/09/01
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1555.003
  - attack.t1003
  - attack.t1037.001
  - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\gpscript.exe'
      - '\userinit.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
  selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Login Data'

      - 'Edge\User Data'
      - 'BraveSoftware'
      - 'Mozilla\Firefox'
      - 'CryptUnprotectData'
      - 'AesGcm'
      - 'Encrypted_key'
      - 'IPScanner.ps1'
      - 'LogonScript.bat'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cli
falsepositives:
  - Enterprise password-management or browser-migration tooling deployed via GPO (rare; should be allowlisted by hash)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\gpscript.exe OR *\\GPScript.exe OR *\\GPSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\userinit.exe OR *\\UserInit.exe OR *\\USERINIT.EXE) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe) @CommandLine:(*"Login Data"* OR *"Chrome\\User Data"* OR *"Edge\\User Data"* OR *BraveSoftware* OR *"Mozilla\\Firefox"* OR *CryptUnprotectData* OR *AesGcm* OR *Encrypted_key* OR *IPScanner* OR *LogonScript.bat*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(gpscript|userinit)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(Login\\s+Data|Chrome\\\\User\\s+Data|Edge\\\\User\\s+Data|BraveSoftware|Mozilla\\\\Firefox|CryptUnprotectData|AesGcm|Encrypted_key|IPScanner|LogonScript\\.bat)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([SHA256HashData, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(as=Executions), count(field=aid, distinct=true, as=HostCount), collect([ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine], limit=20)])
| HostCount >= 3
| sort(HostCount, order=desc)
